description:
1. Presolicitation notice.

      a. This is a presolicitation notice only. This is not a Request for Quotation (RFQ), a Request for Proposal (RFP), or an Invitation for Bid (IFB). The Government is not soliciting quotes or proposals at this time.

Questions related to this pre-solicitation notice are due by 04/23/2026 @ 12:00 PM PDT

2. Set-Asides: The Government anticipates this will be a Total Small Business Set-Aside.

3. Codes for Services or Supplies

  1. Product Service Code (PSC): J015 - MAINT/REPAIR/REBUILD OF EQUIPMENT- AIRCRAFT AND AIRFRAME STRUCTURAL COMPONENTS
  2. NAICS Code: 488190 - OTHER SUPPORT ACTIVITIES FOR AIR TRANSPORTATION

4. Description

      a. (i) Clear and Concise Description of Supplies or Services:

Service: C-130 Trainer Paint

Brief Description: The Government requires a commercial service to paint a C-130 Trainer. This will include repairs necessary before painting including missing fasteners and removal of corrosion. Also, contractor will ensure aircraft is adequately protected against animal intrusion. See Attachment 1 Statement of Work for specific information and examples of what needs to be painted on the Trainer.

      b. Procedures for Award:

The Government intends to issue a Request for Quotation (RFQ) and award a firm-fixed-price purchase order. The award basis is anticipated to be Lowest-Priced, Technically Acceptable (LPTA).

Anticipated Award Date: On or about 05/25/2026

      c. Trade Agreements Language: Not Applicable

      d. Technical Data: Not Applicable

      e. Construction Contract Information: Not Applicable.

      f. Statement Regarding Responsible Sources: All responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency.

      g. Competitive Status: This is a competitive action.

      h. Qualification Requirement: Not Applicable
